name: jogo-da-velha
description: Jogo da velha cyberpunk para web e Android.

scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
scripts.open:android: npm run sync:android && cap open android
scripts.build:apk: node scripts/ensure-debug-keystore.mjs && npm run sync:android && node scripts/build-apk.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync:android && node scripts/build-apk.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.build:release-bundle: npm run sync:android && node scripts/build-apk.mjs bundleRelease
